Its roots give the displayed trace and the ten listed orbit counts; labelled closed walks count labelled configurations without a spatial quotient and each nonfixed temporal orbit has size three. The displayed rooted 2- and 3-cycles generate every length n≥3, and the subleading root moduli are ≤√3.
